task.title: Use All settings
task.shortdesc: Open All settings for a saved profile when you need complete visual control beyond the shorter Guided workflow.

prereq.p: A saved profile exists. New unsaved drafts must be saved before All settings can open.

context.p: All settings is the complete visual editor for Firefox policies and known managed preferences. It opens in Review mode so attention items are visible before broad catalog browsing.

image.alt: All settings showing the review list, configured settings, and setting detail panel on a narrow screen.

step.cmd: Open the saved profile from the Library.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Choose the All settings editor surface.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Confirm that Review, Configured, and Catalog modes are available.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use the mode that matches the task: Review for attention, Configured for applied values, or Catalog for every supported setting.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The saved profile is open in All settings with the correct mode available.

postreq.p: Recovery: if All settings is unavailable, save the Guided draft first or reopen a saved profile from the Library.
